project.name: Capital Place Hanoi
project.primary_business_goal: Generate qualified office leasing interest and private viewing intent.

constraints: Preserve current public routes unless an explicit redirect plan is approved.
Use first-party Capital Place facts and imagery; do not invent pricing, commercial terms, live inventory or certifications.
Public availability is planning-reference plus leasing-confirmation only until a verified inventory source is connected.
Leasing forms prepare an email only until a verified CRM or server endpoint exists.
English is the only implemented locale; do not mark Vietnamese as active until translated content is connected.
Do not use scripts/build_pages.py to regenerate the current pages.
Preserve the white, graphite and cream visual system with restrained orange for primary actions and locator cues.
Mobile must be recomposed intentionally and preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion and safe-area behavior.
